pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Defeat Bone Stalker and Overgrown Colossus first. Ancient Guardian is not a prerequisite. This is world history, not proof of personal participation. Dedicated servers retain hosted encounter admission; singleplayer uses native combat. The encounter owner awards eyes and trophies.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: This set’s stronger encounters span exploration, MAIN, gatekeeper and continuation roles.
